landing.faq.description: Everything you need to know about AgentResolve. Can't find the answer you're looking for? Contact our support team.
landing.faq.items.customization.answer: Everything is editable. Use the visual editor to adjust scenes on the timeline and animate each object individually until the video looks exactly how you want.
landing.faq.items.customization.question: How do I customize the design?
landing.faq.items.getting_started.answer: Sign up for free, describe the video you want in a sentence, and the AI agent delivers an editable draft in minutes. Refine it in the editor and render when you're ready.
landing.faq.items.multiple_projects.answ: Yes! The Free plan includes 3 videos per month, Pro includes 30 and Business includes 150, with workspaces for your team and API access on Business.

landing.faq.items.production_ready.answe: Absolutely. Paid plans export without watermark, in 1080p or 4K, and the deterministic render guarantees the same polished MP4 every time.
landing.faq.items.production_ready.quest: Are the videos ready to publish?
landing.faq.items.support.answer: Yes! We provide support in Portuguese, English and Spanish to help you make the most of AgentResolve.
landing.faq.items.support.question: Do you offer support?
landing.faq.items.tech_stack.answer: AgentResolve renders deterministic MP4 files: 720p on the Free plan, 1080p on Pro and up to 4K on Business.
